source_assessments.assessment: Original PWY8008 contains exactly RXN19819,18395,18393,19820,19821,19822,19823. The draft covers all seven; SbnG citrate supply, SbnD export, uptake and iron loading remain explicitly outside this named entry. No convenient subroute substituted.

Independent original-RDF replay verifies all 40 sides, seven balances and eight continuity relations. Weighting the I/A/B precursor reactions twice and four assembly steps once cancels all internal DAP/ACEGA/OPS/citryl intermediates; five ATP are consumed (two ADP and three AMP products). This is formal equation accounting, not a measured flux/ATP yield. Native DAP/ACEGA protonation and native citrate stereochemical underspecification remain visible.

Original PMC5912478 sec11 establishes Newman DNA, engineered start and tags, not identity of the entire expressed construct to the genomic sequence. Sec4 supports predominant full-length dimer; sec7 shows active truncated monomer. Sec5 directly tests free-serine kinase. These are compatible with the draft’s separate NCTC native complex and Newman functional activity assertions.

The thesis original Methods2.3.2/2.3.3 and Results4.2.1/4.2.2, Figures4-2/4-3/4-4 directly support Newman-derived preparations, OPS/glutamate to ACEGA and NAD-dependent oxidative hydrolysis to DAP/2-oxoglutarate. Both directions of SbnB are assayed. The later 2016 original independently supports Newman SbnA, PLP/Lys47 and solution dimer. Thesis4.2.4 gives SbnB solution dimer. The 2011 genetics paper supports precursor-supply physiology, not the later exact mechanism.

I independently read the complete 2009 Wiley main text through the web tool. The SbnE/H/F/C sections and Fig7A-D support the four-step sequence; the methods identify Newman coding regions expressed in E. coli. Tagged preparations and mixed C/E/F oligomers remain distinct from native genomic proteins. Mg omission is a whole-system assay, not a metal-binding stoichiometry measurement. The original mass assays alone do not adjudicate endpoint connectivity.

Independent visual reading of original2015 SI S7/S38/S39/S42 confirms cyclic hemiaminal structures, equilibrating lactamization and an epimer mixture; the analogue and citrate epimer are separately labeled. Current ChEBI136993 and IUBMB6.3.2.56 explicitly define the formal open-chain alpha-ketoamide equation product. The 2010 crystal source sec21 is iron-bound receptor preparation and is not proof of exclusively linear free physiological product. The draft explicitly chooses a formal equation convention and rejects exact linear/cyclic equivalence. This is a defensible qualified representation, not a newly confirmed scientific conflict blocker or an absolute-form adjudication.

All seven versioned Newman GenPept translations match original genome CDS translations and current NCTC UniProt native sequences. Strain identities are retained separately. Both native SbnI/B complexes explicitly have two corresponding NCTC components and reaction links. Six cofactor edges have source support, with PLP experiment versus qualified Mg annotation/system dependence distinguished.
